description: The ui-health provider supplies the canonical `experience` phase, combining static UI contracts and runtime evaluation while preserving the provider's direct validation command.

requirements.description: Test Genie must expose the ui-health provider through the canonical `experience` phase and include runtime evaluation when available. The direct `ui-health validate scenario <name> --json` command remains available for provider-local diagnostics.
requirements.title: test-genie experience phase integration

validation.notes: The `experience` descriptor is owned by ui-health and selects runtime evaluation
The delegated provider returns the ui-health assessment with canonical `experience` identity
Each Finding in the Report JSON is mapped to a test-genie Observation with type, message, and severity fields
Experience verdict is based on measured evidence, not an empty report alone
Unavailable browser/runtime evidence is represented as not-evaluated and cannot pass
Run test-genie on a scenario with known manifest violations and confirm Observations appear in test-genie output corresponding to each Finding
Run `test-genie` with `--phases experience` and confirm it returns one served-UI verdict
Spec contract checks remain available independently through `experience-contract`
The single experience invocation does not duplicate the former ui-health verdict
Runtime experience evidence and spec authoring/contract findings retain distinct phase ownership

title: test-genie experience phase integration
